description: This file defines the LogLocator enum which provides methods and properties to locate, manage, and retrieve log files within a specified directory, primarily for use with logging and process management.

classes.name: LogLocator
classes.description: A utility enum for locating and managing log files within a directory, with static methods and properties for access and maintenance.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Returns the most recent log file based on modification date within the configured log directory.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the file path for launchd stdout/stderr logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the file path for Gateway launchd job stdout/stderr logs.
